description:
As a customer, I want to search so I can find a tool quickly.

* A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
* A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
* Search is case-insensitive.
* Clearing the search restores the full product list.

Search matches product names (partial, case-insensitive)

criteria.text: A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
Clearing the search restores the full product list.

cases.title: Search term matching existing products lists only matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list contains at least one product whose name contains "Hammer" (e.g. "Hammer") and several products whose names do not contain "Hammer" (e.g. "Screwdriver", "Wrench").
steps: Note the full set of products displayed.
Enter "Hammer" in the search field and run the search.
cases.expected: Only the products whose name contains "Hammer" are listed; products such as "Screwdriver" and "Wrench" are not shown.

cases.title: Search term with no matches shows an empty state message and no error
cases.preconditions: The product list contains products, and none of their names contain the string "zzzqwx".
steps: Enter "zzzqwx" in the search field and run the search.
cases.expected: No products are listed and an empty state message is shown (exact wording not specified in the story). No error is shown.

cases.title: Search is case-insensitive
cases.preconditions: The product list contains a product named "Hammer".
steps: Enter "hammer" (all lowercase) in the search field and run the search.
Clear the field, enter "HAMMER" (all uppercase) and run the search.
cases.expected: Both searches list the product "Hammer"; the results are the same regardless of the letter case used.

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list contains several products, including at least one named "Hammer" and others that do not contain "Hammer".
steps: Open the product list page and note the full set of products displayed.
Enter "Hammer" in the search field and run the search so that the list is filtered.
cases.expected: The full product list is displayed again, matching the set of products noted in step 1.

cases.title: Partial product name matches
cases.preconditions: The product list contains a product named "Hammer" and at least one product whose name does not contain "amm".
steps: Enter the partial name "amm" in the search field and run the search.
cases.expected: The product "Hammer" is listed because its name contains the entered fragment; products whose names do not contain "amm" are not listed.
